title: How social algorithms really work in 2024: circles, engagement and being social
summary: Tibo explains his model of how Twitter and LinkedIn distribute content: followers matter little, and posts spread circle by circle based on engagement. He draws action points: make engaging content, use short video, and engage with people around you.

principles.text: Platforms are becoming TikTok: follower count matters little, so small accounts can go viral and big ones stay dead.
principles.quote: every platform is becoming TikTok. And your followers don’t matter.

principles.text: Content is distributed circle by circle; it keeps spreading only while each circle's engagement stays above a threshold.
principles.quote: When you post, your content is shown to circle A. If that group interacts with the content, then it’s shown to circle B. If they interact too — it’s shown to circle C and so on.

principles.text: Engagement beats reputation now; make content that hooks people or it never reaches your own audience.
principles.quote: Now, if your content is not engaging enough - it will never reach your audience in the first place.

principles.text: Funnel broad, surface-level social content audiences into a newsletter for deeper conversation.
principles.quote: You can then funnel those people into your newsletter for a deeper conversation.

principles.text: Start short-form video now and repurpose one video across all platforms.
principles.quote:
1 short form vid =

1 Instagram reel + 1 YouTube short + 1 LinkedIn video + 1 Twitter video + 1 TikTok

principles.text: Grow by being social: engaging with people around you builds your Circle A, which unlocks wider reach.
principles.quote: You can’t win in isolation anymore. Engage with people around you and you will feel a boost in your metrics too.
